messages:
ari.sales: Quick sync from the AcmeBank call — they want SSO + SCIM + RBAC for the POC. Security asked for SAML metadata and the filled questionnaire. Also flagged domain proof and tenant isolation questions.

sam.eng: I can take SAML metadata and SP config. Which IdP are they using?

julia.ae: Okta + Entra ID mentioned on the call. They also want pricing for a 2-week dedicated POC window (low-latency config).

mike.security: Send the security questionnaire to security@redwood.com. Key asks: signed assertions, SP-initiated SSO, SLO support, ephemeral key handling, and data residency. Can they share IdP metadata xml today?

ari.sales: They said they can share metadata by EOD. On domain proof: they want domain-locked tenant so only *.acmebank.com can register. Is that supported?

kevin.eng: We support domain verification + domain-locked tenant in Private and Dedicated modes. For Hosted we can emulate via org-level allowlist but it requires a quick onboarding ACL. Also note: group->role mapping (RBAC) is gated behind enterprise feature-flag (we can enable for POC).

sam.eng: SCIM notes: we support SCIM v2 with PATCH and bulk sync. Minimal attributes we need: userName, externalId, active, displayName, emails, and an extension for roles/entitlements. Example mapping snippet we send to customers: 

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jdoe@acmebank.com",
  "externalId": "12345",
  "active": true,
  "roles": ["analyst", "reviewer"]
}
```

kevin.eng: FYI: SCIM provisioning runs as a background worker on Dedicated; rate limit for bulk import is 500 users/min by default. We can bump limits for the POC window if needed.

julia.ae: Pricing Q: they asked for an estimate — 2 g4dn GPUs for 2 weeks vs hosted per-token. We should propose: POC Dedicated (2x A10G equiv) + onboarding support = estimate USD 6k for 2 weeks incl. 2x incident credits and 4 hours SE time. Thoughts?

mike.security: Also confirm KMS/HSM integration for key encryption if they're doing Private. If they need HSM we have an add-on. For the questionnaire: they want our data retention policy, incident response, and penetration test cadence. I'll attach docs.

ari.sales: Can we waive the onboarding fee? They pushed back on commercials.

julia.ae: We can offer waived onboarding for POC if they commit to a follow-up evaluation within 30 days and a pilot order > $30k. I'll propose that.

sam.eng: One technical blocker: their IdP enforces signed logout and uses SHA-256 signatures; our SP supports SHA-256 but we need to confirm libs on their side. Ask them to provide a sample SAML Response for validation (redact PII).

kevin.eng: Also note for RBAC: roles mapping via SCIM requires explicit claim mapping from IdP -> SCIM roles OR SAML attribute -> roles. If they want email domain-only mapping (all @acmebank => basic_user) we can provide a simple rule. If they want mapping by Okta group GUID we need group sync enabled.

deploy-bot: POC env created: https://console.redwood.example/poc/acmebank-1768524680 — credentials shared with AE.

ari.sales: Nice. Next steps: 1) ask Acme to share IdP metadata + sample SAML response, 2) send security questionnaire, 3) confirm SCIM attribute mapping and number of users to provision, 4) finalize pricing estimate draft. Who owns which item?

sam.eng: I'll validate SAML + provide SP metadata by EOD.

mike.security: I'll send the questionnaire now and follow up on retention/pen-test docs.

julia.ae: I'll send pricing draft and the onboarding waiver terms. Will also request user count and expected concurrency.

kevin.eng: I'll prepare SCIM mapping doc and a short runbook for POC (rate limits, troubleshooting endpoints, logs to inspect).

ari.sales: Perfect. I'll cc the customer and loop back once we have metadata + questionnaire answers. :thumbsup:

julia.ae: One more thing — they asked about audit logs for admin actions (role changes, token creation). We support audit logs with 90d retention on Dedicated; add-on for longer retention.

mike.security: Confirmed. Also recommend they enable MFA for admin accounts during the POC.

ari.sales: Thanks all — I'll update the thread after Acme responds.
